scope: Independent read-only design review; digital implementation allowed, physical acceptance withheld

reviewers.summary: Revisión independiente de diseño completada. Recomiendo estudiar la propuesta de marco y vidrio a 13.39 mm como prototipo digital nominal, con batería sobre el suelo a 1.4 mm y cubierta superior desmontable nivelada. La reducción propuesta es de 1.41 mm respecto a 14.8 mm. La recomendación no constituye aceptación geométrica del candidato ni compatibilidad física verificada.

findings.claim: La pareja Samtec SLW/TLW aporta una base dimensional documentada: cuerpo de socket de 4.57 mm más aislante de header de 1.52 mm producen 6.09 mm entre placas. Desde PCB principal a 5.4 mm, el PCB de pantalla queda a 11.49 mm y el vidrio nominal a 13.39 mm. El poste de 2.67 mm está dentro del intervalo declarado de inserción de 2.16–2.92 mm. Confianza alta en esta aritmética nominal.
evidence: https://suddendocs.samtec.com/catalog_english/slw.pdf
https://suddendocs.samtec.com/catalog_english/tlw_th.pdf
tools/freecad/components.py: niceview(), PCB de 1 mm y vidrio de 0.9 mm.

findings.claim: Bajar la batería de 2.0 a 1.4 mm eliminando material bajo la celda, y bajar la jaula 0.6 mm conservando sus pies, es una alternativa nominal coherente. El MCU propuesto a 8.2 mm deja 0.387 mm sobre el cuerpo del socket modelado. Deben comprobarse retención, aislamiento, soldaduras, cables y desmontaje. No hay engagement físico medido.
evidence: tools/freecad/build_revI.py: Floor=1.4 mm, BatteryBottom previo=2.0 mm y socket MCU de 2.413 mm sobre PCBTop=5.4 mm.
design/batteries.json: perfiles nominales Adafruit 1570 y 301230.
Propuesta revisada: conservación de ambas baterías, apoyos desmontables y rutas completas de 105 mm.

findings.claim: Una cubierta superior desmontable con huecos derivados de las envolventes de las caps permite estudiar la ocultación de switches manteniendo centros, ángulos y montaje Choc. Debe conservarse la geometría de retención de la placa original. Los huecos de switch de 14×14 mm no sustituyen las reservas de las KLP Lamé.
evidence: tools/freecad/build_revI.py: placa de Z=6.3..7.6 mm y cortes de switch de 14×14 mm.
design/layout.json: 36 centros y ángulos conservados.
Propuesta revisada: cubierta nivelada con huecos combinados o borde perimetral y servicio desmontable.

findings.claim: La compatibilidad entre las familias Samtec no demuestra que el poste entre en el agujero del nice!view adquirido. El dibujo oficial no dimensiona ese diámetro. La representación nominal existente no autoriza ampliar ni taladrar la placa comercial. La conclusión requiere dimensiones toleranciadas o medición del módulo real.
evidence: https://nicekeyboards.com/static/2f2592ff1ff8021932814b20cb76e3c4/a6d36/niceview_dimensions.png
https://suddendocs.samtec.com/catalog_english/tlw_th.pdf
https://typeractive.xyz/products/no-solder-spring-headers

findings.claim: La reserva sobre el display debe incluir terminal y soldadura completos. Con PCB de pantalla a 11.49 mm, espesor de 1 mm y cola sobresaliente de 0.3 mm, el terminal alcanza 12.79 mm. Una cubierta de 0.6 mm bajo el techo de 13.39 mm llega exactamente a esa cota y no deja holgura. Deben verificarse alivios y respaldo de cada decoración.
evidence: tools/freecad/components.py: espesor nominal de PCB nice!view.
Propuesta revisada: recorte de terminal y alivios locales del marco.

findings.claim: La altura propuesta solo puede aceptarse digitalmente después de comprobar interferencias, espesores, continuidad de sólidos, ambos perfiles de batería, cables y servicio. La cubierta necesita barridos continuos de todas las variantes y orientaciones KLP admitidas hasta 3.5 mm de recorrido conservador. Las comprobaciones anteriores excluían las mallas de switches y caps.
evidence: validation/revI-mechanical.json: alcance de la comprobación histórica.
https://www.kailhswitch.com/info/kailh-kl-switches-pg1350-series-23772219.html
docs/slim-flush.md: límites de aceptación digital y física.

recommendations: Proceder con un candidato digital aislado a 13.39 mm, preservando la referencia anterior y sin declararlo mínimo físico.
Mantener ambos perfiles de batería, módulos reemplazables, hotswap, 36 centros y ángulos, frames magnéticos y variantes KLP admitidas.
Verificar en el candidato guardado todos los cruces entre cubierta, frames, componentes, cables y barridos de caps, además del desmontaje completo.
Modelar terminales y soldadura sin reducir sus reservas para obtener artificialmente un resultado sin colisiones.
Mantener explícitamente pendiente la compatibilidad del agujero del nice!view y el engagement real. Mediciones incompatibles o una colisión del candidato falsificarían la solución propuesta.

reviewers.summary: The independent design review supports proceeding with the 13.39 mm proposal as a nominal digital prototype, including floor-mounted batteries and a removable level shell. The specified connector pair supports the nominal stack arithmetic. This completes advisory review only; full geometry acceptance and physical interface qualification remain required.

findings.claim: The specified SLW/TLW mating pair supports a nominal 6.09 mm separation, placing the display underside at 11.49 mm and modeled glass/frame top at 13.39 mm, a 1.41 mm reduction from 14.8 mm.
evidence: Samtec SLW catalog lists TLW as a mating family, a 4.57 mm body and insertion range 2.16–2.92 mm: https://suddendocs.samtec.com/catalog_english/slw.pdf
Samtec TLW catalog specifies the proposed 1.52 mm insulator and 2.67 mm mating post: https://suddendocs.samtec.com/catalog_english/tlw_th.pdf

findings.claim: Lowering both battery profiles to the 1.4 mm case floor and lowering the cage roof by 0.6 mm is suitable for geometric evaluation. Preserve captured feet, retention, insulation and continuous lead paths to the unchanged PH terminals.
evidence: Reviewed baseline used BatteryBottom=2.0 mm and Floor=1.4 mm.
Both Adafruit 1570 and 301230 remain required.
Finished-pack tolerances, case-floor contact, insulation and lead strain were not physically measured.

findings.claim: A removable upper shell can hide switches while preserving the existing switch plate and key centers. Its openings must clear all admitted cap variants and rotations through the proposed 3.5 mm travel reserve, with merged openings where necessary.
evidence: Reviewed layout contains 18 key centers per half.
The existing plate spans Z=6.3–7.6 mm.
The original mechanical receipt excludes switch/keycap meshes and does not establish full-travel clearance.
Existing display, controller, battery-plug and switch extraction paths must include the new shell or explicitly remove it first.

findings.claim: Commercial nice!view hole diameter, actual controller engagement, solder envelopes and printed backing strength remain unverified. Correct the display-row registration from the official drawing, but do not enlarge a purchased board or claim pin fit from the nominal CAD hole.
evidence: The reviewed nice!view drawing establishes the proposed row location but does not specify drilled-hole diameter.
Proposed alignment is module origin 16.1 mm plus local row 34.7 mm equals J2 row 50.8 mm.
The existing nominal 0.9 mm module-hole model is not a measurement.
Lower controller placement and locally reduced frame backing require explicit clearance and strength qualification.

findings.claim: No unresolved material objection prevents contained digital implementation. Acceptance of 13.39 mm requires saved-geometry checks covering connector bodies and tails, both batteries, full wire routes, cap travel, service paths and all ten frame styles with valid flush material volumes.
evidence: The reviewed proposal was not an accepted candidate geometry.
The original receipt cannot establish the effects of the proposed shell and deeper stack.
Independent review verified the enumerated baseline hashes without changing files.

recommendations: Proceed with the contained nominal prototype and retain every original module, battery, cap, magnetic-frame and service requirement.
Accept the proposed height only after full geometry checks and saved-file readback pass.
Keep physical fit, finger access, retention, insulation and connector engagement explicitly unqualified until measured and tested.
Do not describe the proposal as an absolute physical minimum or manufacturing-ready assembly.

dispositions.finding: Commercial nice!view finished-hole diameter and toleranced .025-inch square-pin fit are unknown.
dispositions.disposition: Keep .9 mm hole as explicit unmeasured nominal; no drilling or hardware fit claim.

dispositions.finding: A 1.2 mm roof would intersect the PCB and solder at 13.39 mm.
dispositions.disposition: Local PCB undercut and open header service well; preserve .8 mm backing requirement where .4 mm inlays exist.

dispositions.finding: Stored battery leads must descend without disconnecting fixed PH terminals.
dispositions.disposition: Continuous radius-controlled 3D ramp; retain 105 mm length and verify terminal positions.

dispositions.finding: Display row was modeled 2.4 mm away from J2.
dispositions.disposition: Use official 1.3 mm end offset and common 50.8 mm row; add registration acceptance.

dispositions.finding: Raised shell can obstruct cap travel and service.
dispositions.disposition: Conservative union of all admitted cap variants and rotations over full3.5 mm travel; preserve removable switch plate and existing3 mounting screws.

implementation_corrections.finding: Fixed socket tails were initially too short in the candidate model
implementation_corrections.disposition: Full 2.92 mm tail preserved to Z2.48; actual exported native checked.

implementation_corrections.finding: Lowered MCU support and battery locator intersected socket body and lead
implementation_corrections.disposition: Full-height ledges narrowed laterally; local open wire exit added. Final nominal check has no intersections.

implementation_corrections.finding: Axis-aligned thumb switch withdrawal boxes created false intersections
implementation_corrections.disposition: Continuous withdrawal retains each rotated source-mesh bound; no cap/switch center, angle or geometry changed.
